spot_checks.sea: Core thesis and practice takeaway preserve pneumomediastinum without antecedent positive-pressure ventilation and diagnostic vigilance.
Preserves PaO2:FiO2 ratios 68, 80, 59 and onset days 15, 14, 36.
States mechanism remains unclear and design cannot estimate incidence or causal attribution.
Embeds all three chest radiographs; Fig. 1 includes small right apical pneumothorax and Figs. 2-3 pneumomediastinum.

warnings: The article has no formal Methods section; the SEA appropriately treats design characterization as descriptive case-series inference and does not invent a formal protocol.
